_template_notes: coverage-report.json — Machine-readable coverage metrics (song hành với coverage-report.md). Schema: coverage-report-v1 (v10.11.0 — mới). Writer: scripts/wf-fix-bugs/generate-phase5-reports.sh (Phase 5 Step 5.11). Strip _template_notes/_schema_notes trước khi write.
_schema_notes: Required: $schema, session_id, generated_at, dimensions[], distribution, totals. dimensions[] item: {dimension_id, probes_run:int, probes_total:int, coverage_pct:int (0-100), signals_found:int}. distribution.by_severity {critical, high, medium, low, info} (count + pct). totals {dims_covered:int, dims_total:int, dims_skipped:[ids], probe_success_rate:int (0-100)}. Consumer: Phase 7 reports (orchestrator-summary uses dimensions[] for breakdown), wf-prepare-deployment optional consumer.
